reviews.review:
This could have been a good game. It feels fun for awhile slaughtering orkz but when you start progressing through the single player mode you begin to realize it's a very unfinished game. The normal mode is way too easy as enemies will literally run away from you and you'll be sent through empty hallways and arena areas where it looks like there's supposed to be enemies of some sort. The plot is pretty crap as well. 

Multiplayer was bad when it came out and so obviously it's dead now.

The only redeeming qualities of the game was the gun play and level design. The guns feel powerful and the levels have that "epic" Warhammer feel to them. An example would be the grand and elaborate factories and bridges you'll see in the background.

I would only reccommend if it's on sale for a low price or part of a bundle. Definitely not worth $30.

I have never played a Warhammer 40k game before this one and I easly managed to get a hang of the story behind who my enemies are and tells a good chunk of the universe in this game. The gameplay is solid and fun when there is a variety of weapons you can use to kill your enemies with, including some jetpack sequences of the game which is soo much fun to where I always wanted to have it on through the whole game. The game brings challenging opponents into the battle which makes tedious enemy waves turn into challenging and interesting battles which can sometimes lead to your death. Boss battles are really fun and every boss is unique in their own way with funny dialogue and cool character models. For a starter who has never played any game related to Warhammer 40k, this is the game to start with.

This game was great and I really hope there is a sequel. I wasn't really fond of the multiplayer, but the coop survival mode is the most fun. I don't really have much to say about this game other than the combat kicked ass, didn't feel repetative and was somewhat true to the lore of the series. They did an excellent job with the immersion and escapist gothic theme that surrounds the Imperium's Space Marines. Orcs and Chaos were definitely a great mix. 

One thing I wish would happen from the developers is to make stories from each race that are interconnected to the lore. Fire Warrior did okay and this game was definitely an excellent introduction to the warhammer universe.

A fun game, not that long unfortunately but ends on a cliffhanger possibly setting up a warhammer space marine 2  :D Still its a fun game and can be played many different ways and isn't very difficult
Good fun-packed game, especially if playing with friends. Decent graphics and gameplay for a console port.
